reserveReview.rationale: The reviewed Goal3 documentation and contract evidence support an issuer-controlled zkUSD portal and a Goal3-held collateral pool, but they do not publish a reserve inventory, collateral categories, current balances, independent assurance, or a same-notional reserve reconciliation. The existing aggregate pool is retained without inventing constituents.
